description: Activate or pause a workflow. Scheduled workflows have their Trigger.dev schedule activated/deactivated to match. Activating a workflow that runs on a schedule, webhook or event needs the mcp:run scope, since it then starts runs on its own; pausing never does. Pausing keeps the steps and run history; prefer it to delete_workflow.

is_active.description: true to activate the workflow so its trigger starts runs, false to pause it.

workflow_id.description: Automation (workflow) UUID, from list_workflows or create_workflow.

name: toggle_workflow

is_active.description: The state the workflow is now in.

title: Toggle workflow
